envelope.description: Gate the remaining file-modifying RPC methods

body.title: Gate the remaining file-modifying RPC methods
body.summary: Call the gate for every other modifying method of the table (workflow.resolveComment, workflow.reviewDecision, workflow.reviewArtifact, workflow.resolveFinding, tracker.sync, tracker.setup, tracker.attach, tracker.syncComments, repo.convert, team.refresh, team.claim, team.release, artifact.feedback.append, artifact.feedback.add and any other t1 marked), and remove process.env['INSRC_REPO'] and their own no-repo checks (repo-convert.ts, tracker-attach.ts, tracker-sync-comments.ts, workflow-rpc.ts, feedback, resolve-comment and review-decision handlers). Update the tests that pin the fallback.
acceptanceChecks: each table method called with no repo is refused and the file system is unchanged
no remaining use of the daemon's INSRC_REPO for a table method
the tests of the changed handlers pass with an absolute registered repo

tests.name: repo-gate-dispatch.test.ts: each method in the table called with no repo is refused and leaves the file system unchanged
